Integrates fourteen independently reviewed contributions, retaining
their source, partial reconstruction, original contribution credit and
complete measured output. #1091 is excluded because its independent
reviews are unfinished.

The batch adds reviewed engine/audio/path/speech bodies and promotes
twenty exact units. All source/header integration was conflict-free:
each of the 56 source/header files matches its reviewed constituent
head. Only metadata needed conflict resolution. No toolchain,
compiler-profile, workflow or approval-control changes are introduced.

## Work coordination

The owner approved replacing broad, permanent claims with bounded
active-work reservations. CONTRIBUTING.md now makes backlog/research and
old umbrella claims nonexclusive, opens existing partials to improvement
unless actively reserved, expires reservations after48hours without
meaningful progress, and requires coordination for live overlaps/shared
files. AGENTS.md points to this canonical policy. Original credit,
matching integrity, independent review and merge controls are unchanged.
The owner separately cleared #1096/#1110’s scope overlap.

## Validation and retained limitations

Existing substantive accuracy and hostile reviews carry forward. Focused
integration review covers metadata unions, source/declaration
dependencies, provenance and the policy change. Pinned-toolchain
compilation passed all131 changed source modes and affected
shared-header consumers; manifest and candidate-map loading pass at457
linked units,524 comparison units and27 candidate groups. No redundant
full local comparisons/test suite was run; one final combined CI
supplies final binary/comparison/export proof.

Expected new exact credit is256 functions, subject to final combined
measurement. Promotions retain original authorship. Unresolved
signatures, nominal identities and original-file boundaries stay
explicitly uncertain; useful partial source remains submitted rather
than discarded. #1107 retains its conservative int-return partials; no
pending optional return-type decision is needed for this source. #1109’s
disclosed fn_801B22B0 partial fuzzy decline and #1115’s expanded partial
literal block (-4 exact data bytes) remain visible, not concealed by
aggregate gains.

Final exact-revision review records, actual-squash attribution
validation and trusted combined CI must pass before merge. Original PRs
will be closed as incorporated only after merge and a fresh head check.

Final
[CI40187708499](https://github.com/mitsevox/nflstreet2/actions/runs/40187708499)
passes on `28ae716dbd664a86d961e02b78a884bf2a31fb08`. Authenticated
artifact12597102163 confirms complete byte-identical output, all256 new
exact full extents, 12,119 exact=credited functions, 2,454 supported
names,457 linked units, both maps and actual-squash provenance. No prior
published function exact/fuzzy/link regression. Code linked
increases29,756bytes and data linked2,333bytes. Original credit
correction: two existing speech bodies preserve original PR763; author
adampreddy and current refinement pins remain unchanged.
